input: Find a local philately club for stamp collectors

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's city, region, or country is the single most important factor — without a location, no relevant clubs can be found.
Some clubs focus on specific areas of philately (e.g., first-day covers, airmail, a specific country's stamps), so knowing whether any specialism matters narrows the search.
Knowing who the collector is (adult, child, beginner, veteran) determines whether a general club or a youth/beginner-friendly group is a better fit.
Maximum travel distance or willingness to attend online-only meetings affects which clubs are actually reachable and worth considering.
Some people want a social/trading environment; others want expert talks or competitive exhibitions — the meeting format and club culture should match what the user values most.
Knowing preferred meeting frequency and day/time (evenings, weekends) rules out clubs whose schedules are incompatible.
Understanding the end goal — just attending one meeting, joining formally, or finding a long-term community — defines what a successful outcome actually looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local philately club to join
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a nearby philately (stamp collecting) club they can participate in.

questions.title: What city or region are you based in?
questions.description: The user's location is the primary filter for finding any relevant local club.

questions.title: Do you collect a specific type or era of stamps?
questions.description: Identifies whether the user needs a specialist club (e.g., Victorian, thematic, airmail) or a general philately group.

questions.title: Are you a beginner, or an experienced collector?
questions.description: Determines whether a welcoming beginner-friendly club or an advanced/competitive club is the better match.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to attend meetings?
questions.description: Sets the geographic radius for the search and flags whether virtual clubs are acceptable if nothing is nearby.

questions.title: Do you prefer social trading nights or educational talks?
questions.description: Distinguishes between clubs that prioritise informal swapping/buying versus structured programmes with presentations and exhibitions.

questions.title: What days or times work best for you to attend?
questions.description: Rules out clubs whose regular meeting schedule conflicts with the user's availability.

questions.title: Are you looking to join formally or just visit first?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the goal is a one-off exploratory visit or committing to full membership, which affects what steps come next.
